title: Great Equatorial Building, Royal Observatory Greenwich
visualBrief: Independent Great Equatorial Building: octagonal stock-brick three-storey base, pale string/cornice bands, sash lights/red flat arches, bracketed white projecting gallery, broad pale-green onion dome with curved seams/closed shutter cue and small fenced crown. Keep the Meridian range, all earlier Observatory assets and every separate building as context. No telescope optics, furnished rooms, operating dome or copied signs.

sourceFacts.horizontalBasis: Shared campus Q192988 plus unique way268533517/native35184640622349, declared independent Great Equatorial Building. Standard map gives a16-vertex rounded footprint and11m height; photos establish the octagonal base and larger onion dome. Own anchor raw[17,13], internalX east,Z south, heading0 baked into native coordinates. Facade/closed slit bearing is a photo-led approximation with15degree uncertainty. Only this footprint may be replaced; retain contiguous Meridian ways268533454/446/457/459.
sourceFacts.architecturalHeights: Mapped11m height is an unqualified control that does not identify dome/base breakdown. Working octagon circumradius5.65m, brick body9.6m, gallery deck6.5m/rail7.6m, onion base9.6m/bulge radius6.05m/crown16.2m and fenced top17m are photo-led estimates, not a surveyed overall height. Dome seams, closed slit bearing, gallery extent, sash/arch counts and concealed rear/door are approximations. Pale painted metal is an explicit shared substitute for painted wood gallery rails. No operational optics/interior, copied signage or certified access.
